tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The ground of every Daftar surface, 70% of the ratio. Body, muted and ink text sit on it; rust only as large text, a rule or one accent word.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Alternate section bands and placeholder fills. Ink, body and muted text read on it.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, callouts and register boxes with a 1px rule border. Ink, body and muted text read on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All headings, the page of the mark, and the one ink section per page (25% of the ratio). Text on paper, soft and card.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Running text on paper, soft and card (7.5 : 1 on paper).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Mono labels, captions and footers on paper, soft and card (5.0 : 1 on paper, 4.7 : 1 on soft). Never on ink.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines and card borders. Decorative, never text.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: The 5%: the folded corner, the italic accent word, rules and large text on paper, soft and card. Never body copy. Never on ink: 2.7 : 1.

tokens.name: rust-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and deep state for rust on paper (8.7 : 1 on paper).

tokens.name: rust-on-ink
tokens.usage: The only rust allowed on ink: the accent word and large text (5.75 : 1 on ink).

tokens.name: body-on-ink
tokens.usage: Running text inside an ink section (9.4 : 1 on ink). Taken from the guide's inked panel.

tokens.name: muted-on-ink
tokens.usage: Mono labels inside an ink section (6.0 : 1 on ink). Taken from the guide's inked panel.

tokens.name: rule-on-ink
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines inside an ink section. Decorative, never text.

families.serif: "Fraunces", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "JetBrains Mono", Georgia, serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace
families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Fraunces", "JetBrains Mono", Tahoma, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Display. Fraunces 400, opsz 144, SOFT 40. One accent word in rust italic.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page and section headings. One accent word in rust italic.
styles.sample: A memo your auditor will accept

styles.name: heading-2
styles.sample: One position, read against the standard

styles.name: heading-3
styles.sample: The working shown, the file handed over

styles.name: accent
styles.usage: The single accent word: Fraunces italic in rust, on paper. On ink use rust-on-ink.

styles.name: body-web
styles.usage: Running text on the web, in body on paper.
styles.sample: One position, read against the standard, written up with the working shown.

styles.name: body-print
styles.usage: Running text in print: 14px is 10.5pt. Use 10.5 to 11pt. Tables use tabular lining numerals.
styles.sample: One position, read against the standard.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions and secondary text in body or muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrows, always leading with § . Uppercase, JetBrains Mono 400, tracked +0.22em, in muted.

styles.name: chapter-mark
styles.usage: Chapter marks and service codes. Uppercase, tracked +0.26em, in ink.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Register figures and footers. Tabular figures.

styles.name: arabic-display
styles.usage: Arabic display. Right-aligned. The accent word takes rust and weight 500; Arabic has no italic.

styles.name: arabic-body
styles.usage: Arabic running text in body. Right-aligned, never tracked.
styles.sample: نكتب الموقف أولاً، ثم نعرض العمل والدليل.

styles.name: arabic-label
styles.usage: Arabic labels in muted. Never tracked: tracking breaks the joins.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base-8 step. Gaps inside a label or list row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between related blocks; card padding vertical.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps between groups, rule-to-content.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between chapters; page top margin in print.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Print side margins on letters; largest section gap.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Placeholders, small chips and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, callouts, buttons.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every divider and card border, in rule. Never a drop shadow.

tokens.name: duration-tap
tokens.usage: Tap feedback.

tokens.name: duration-hover
tokens.usage: Hover colour change.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Reveal: fade and 8px rise.

tokens.name: duration-page
tokens.usage: Page transition: fade and 8px rise.

tokens.name: easing-settle
tokens.usage: The one ease, Settle. No bounce, no spinners. Respect reduced motion.
